description: This file implements a client for the Searxng web search engine, including functions for building search URLs, parsing responses, validating URLs, and executing searches with caching and error handling.

methods.name: normalizeSearxngResult
methods.description: Normalizes raw search result data into a structured SearxngResult object, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: buildSearxngSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs a search URL for Searxng with specified parameters.

methods.name: validateSearxngBaseUrl
methods.description: Validates that the provided base URL is a proper HTTP/HTTPS URL and targets a trusted network if using HTTP.

methods.name: parseSearxngResponseText
methods.description: Parses JSON response text from Searxng into an array of search results, respecting the count limit.

methods.name: runSearxngSearch
methods.description: Performs a web search using Searxng, with caching, error handling, and response processing.
